reviewHostOnly: This build previews Lava’s interface. It does not start a VPN, change production filters, authenticate, make purchases, or send reports. Changes in this review session are discarded when you close it.
Optional diagnostics include anonymized data like VPN status, network logs, and your active filter. They help the Lava team figure out what went wrong.
